content: I am trying to study general tilt GBs in FCC Ni, with tilt axis <110>. Please build and relax an FCC Ni {110} || {111} grain boundary. Determine compatible grain orientations and a common tilt axis, then choose suitable initial sizes and an available Ni potential to run the initial minimization. After minimization, render the strucure in both the top and plan view, then analyze possible structural periods.
